name: Amanuensis
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 0, cleric/oracle 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target object or objects with writing
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw Will negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

You cause writing to be copied from one source to another. For example you could copy a book into a blank book. The spell copies one page per minute and creates a perfect duplicate though it is written in your handwriting. This spell copies only non-magical text. So any magical writing (such as spellbooks or scrolls), sigils (such as a sepia snake sigil) or illustrations are left as blank spaces on the page. This spell will trigger rune, sigil and symbol spells (if applicable) even if it does not copy them.

A blank medium (paper, parchment or book) must be provided for the spell to write upon. The spell will automatically turn pages of the source material and the destination medium for copying, if applicable. If there are insufficient blank pages for copying, you are alerted by a light pinging in your head and the spell stops copying until more blank material is provided. At any time, you may change sources or destinations of the copying.

This spell will not translate the text being copied. If you do not understand the original, you cannot understand the copied text.
